work.composition: central red stage with twin planes above
work.description: Mixed-media collage incorporating warplane diagrams, concentric target motifs, reflective compact discs along the lower edge, a chess pawn, football forms, and iridescent vertical strips against layered red, black, and beige ground. Centrally embedded is a dark photographic inset depicting a figure in red and blue tones, surrounded by scattered circular targets and technical aviation schematics.
work.title: Red Stage, Two Planes
